correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the unrescaled roots e_i-e_j for all n>=4 and squared-distance spectrum exactly {2,4,6,8}. At sqrt2 maximal row/column simplices form a crown-graph good-cover nerve with first Betti n^2-3n+1; at scale2 the source/target closure gives equivariant Hom(K2,Kn) and the sphere of the standard representation; at sqrt6 the missing-pair perfect matching yields the join of binomial(n,2) two-point sets and determinant of exterior square sign^(n-1); last stage is a simplex. Distinct homological degrees settle integral bar endpoints. Independent exact distance/clique enumeration for n=4,5 checked stage face vectors and Euler characteristics, and inspected source verifier which tests mod-two ranks and all S4/S5 Lefschetz traces. Structural argument, not the finite n checks, proves all n and quotient rational-invariant claim.
residual_risks: Verification was bounded to the explicitly described finite checks and inspected proof; no broader generalization beyond stated domain.
